render.prompt: Character design reference for a cozy retro top-down adventure game: an elderly, kindly gnu (a wildebeest) who is a retired inventor, with tall shoulders, a heavy shaggy dark mane sagging into a long cream-coloured beard, small upturned horns, gold round spectacles on a string, and a worn brown cardigan with pockets stuffed with pencils and yellow sticky notes, holding a ring of mismatched keys; tired, kind eyes and an apologetic smile. Full body, front view, standing upright facing the viewer, centered, chunky cute proportions with a big head. 16-bit pixel art style, clean flat colours, bold dark outline, simple readable shapes. Plain solid flat magenta background, no shadow, no text, no frame.
